{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
# First, confirm all revenue strings have commas as thousands separators
print("Revenue values with commas:")
print(data['revenue'].str.contains(r',').sum(), "out of", len(data))

# Now clean the revenue column
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the first few cleaned values
print("\nSample of cleaned revenue:")
print(data['revenue_clean'].head())

# Verify that the conversion worked
print("\nDtype of cleaned revenue:", data['revenue_clean'].dtype)"}
